head: 89de9af4b631abdef5673ce8949fb02a32f6fcad + archived workspace
problems: Switching roots resets selected/focused paths, contrary to R02.2 and the existing prototype root-state behavior.
An old-root keyboard RAF callback focuses a same-named item in the new root after switching.
Deleting the focused file leaves all tree items with tabindex=-1.
fix: Retain selection and focus in the workspace session per issued root lease; restore on root switch/remount without changing durable schema or file identities.
Cancel focus RAF on root change/unmount and validate its epoch/root ownership before focusing a connected button. Restore scroll in layout effect, reset shift anchor at root switch as in prototype.
Provide the first navigable tree item as keyboard entry when the stored focused path is absent.
prototype: Read-only source comparison: FileWorkspace.jsx already stores selected/focused/expanded/query/scroll per root via rootStates. Production bug repaired to that reviewed behavior; no new layout or prototype design change. Full P/A not executed.

aggregateLatestCodeResults.basis: Prior full baseline plus affected reruns; not a new full-suite run.

package.officeEvidenceReuse: Office Worker/PPTX Worker and broker hashes equal r9; Office sources unchanged. Retain the r9 20-test evidence, do not label it a new r10 execution.

boundaries: Production React tree/store plus actual native roots/files, deterministic delayed callback injection in jsdom. No native App mouse/keyboard or full pixel acceptance.
B11 and B12 are still incomplete P/I/A formal cases. B07 source deletion handling stays verified at scoped I; full App error state/focus remains to test.
B13 rerun has three extra fixture directories: first/middle/tail DOM count is 19/24/20; timing and Node heap are diagnostic only (GC can make deltas negative).
r10 not started; existing r6 GUI/userData kept untouched. No merge, commit, tag, push or release.
